suggestions.title: Extended low-engagement period
suggestions.message: Engagement stayed low from 00:50 to 01:40 (average 0.41). Consider introducing an interactive activity - a quick poll, think-pair-share or a short worked problem - or revisiting the material from a different angle.

suggestions.title: Engagement declined over the session
suggestions.message: Average engagement was 0.75 in the first half and 0.62 in the second. Consider a short break or energiser near 01:10, or moving demanding content earlier and lighter, practice-based work later.

suggestions.title: Effective teaching segment
suggestions.message: Engagement peaked between 00:00 and 00:40 (average 0.95). Reflect on what you were doing then - the format, pace or interaction - and consider reusing it.

suggestions.title: Long stretch with little spoken interaction
suggestions.message: There was almost no speech from 00:40 to 01:50. If that was not intentional (e.g. silent work), questions, discussion prompts or pair talk could re-open participation.

suggestions.title: Effective teaching segment
suggestions.message: Engagement peaked between 01:50 and 02:30 (average 0.81). Reflect on what you were doing then - the format, pace or interaction - and consider reusing it.

suggestions.title: Noisy interval
suggestions.message: Noise was elevated between 02:10 and 02:30 (engagement averaged 0.78). A classroom-management cue such as a reset signal might help here.

suggestions.title: Early departures
suggestions.message: 1 participant(s) were no longer visible for the final part of the session. Consider sharing a closing summary or materials afterwards.

suggestions.title: Late arrivals
suggestions.message: 1 participant(s) joined after the first 00:12. A brief recap of key points once they settle can help them catch up.
